prompt:
# Task
A customer who has just been registered cannot be read back through the application. Find the capability responsible and fix its implementation, without changing any contract.

report.reason: Root cause: customers.lookup@1 (src/handlers/customers.lookup.mjs) read only the legacy CRM export. customers.register@1 writes new customers to the application store (src/store.mjs), which is the system of record for urn:example:customers:customer. That store is seeded from the same legacy export using the same field mapping. As a result, newly registered customers could not be found. Fix: lookup now reads from the store via getCustomer. It still returns the same output fields and still fails only with NOT_FOUND. No contract was changed. Verified: the contract is unchanged and valid, outputs conform to the schema, answers for existing customers are unchanged for customers.lookup@1 and billing.contact@1, and the declared verification for customers.register@1 now confirms (customer-readable, registered-event).

checks.rule: only the target's implementation module changes
the application loads and answers appport.manifest@1
the published contract is unchanged (contractDigest sha256:4f6660b5135b)
the published contract has no validation errors
every output observed conforms to its declared output schema
customers.lookup@1 fails only with its declared failure codes (NOT_FOUND)
answers on existing state are unchanged for customers.lookup@1, billing.contact@1
customers.register@1: declared verification (customer-readable, registered-event) is not contradicted and every state method confirms
